evidence_cards.content: If the TMC workstations or network server fails, resulting in loss of field status at the TMC, alternate control shall be at FCU South or FCU North. The operator shall be able to dial in from a back up computer to either FCU North or FCU south and open and close the reversible lanes.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative flow where the Operator diverges from normal operations due to system failure (TMC/network) by using a backup computer to access alternate control units (FCU South/North) to successfully maintain lane control.

evidence_cards.content: If FCU North or South fails: (FCU Controller failures or FCU-TSU communications failure) Loss of changeable messages signs and DCUs associated with the failed FCU. Alternate control at the non-failed FCU (North or South).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an alternative flow for partial FCU failure where the Operator switches control to the remaining functional FCU unit to continue operations.

evidence_cards.content: If FCUs North and South both fail... Alternate control units: Direct control at DCUs 1-5, and CMS 1-12 control from CMS cabinets. The operator shall be able to connect a lap top computer at the DCUs and operate the devices or perform manual operation from the MCU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details an alternative flow for total FCU failure where the Operator physically connects a laptop to field devices (DCUs/CMS cabinets) or uses the MCU to manually operate devices, ensuring continued system functionality.

evidence_cards.content: If any DCU 1-5 fails: Field devices related to the failed DCU. Alternate control unit: MCU and manual control at the field devices.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies an alternative flow for DCU failure where the Operator utilizes the MCU or performs manual control at the specific field devices to bypass the failed unit.

evidence_cards.content: If any MCU fails: Loss of field devices. Alternate control unit: Manual control at the field devices related to the failed MCU. The devices can be manually controlled/operated from their cabinets (e.g.: Gates)
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Outlines an alternative flow for MCU failure where the Operator resorts to manual control directly at the device cabinets (such as Gates) to maintain operation.
